response.overview: Based on a true story- A contemplative boy filled with many choices which can only lead to a variety of outcomes, procrastination takes hold, he becomes lazy, not realizing his full potential and what he can make of it. He wastes time and realizes he can't keep his creative mind locked away any longer. So he decides to release his creativity, creating purpose from his imagination while grappling with reality and feelings of sadness and utter frustration.
response.title: Late Night Ponders
